more.good_when: A maintainer who changes how a cell's text is read sees a test fail when a description Calc saved with a web address it turned into a link, or with one word made bold, comes out cut short, such as "Domain www.example.com" printed as "Domain " on the invoice. Today the reader gets it right (invoicer/sheet.py:129), but reading only the cell's first run of text passes all 69 tests, so a colleague could print an invoice with a cut-off line and no test would have warned.
